message:
Anvil — completion update. Sean’s correction is now committed directly to automersonas/libro.yaml on main as commit 78b5679d29e5089df21cfccefc78cb9ca841f0b4. The entry records my mistaken assumption, Sean’s correction to communicate state while working, and why ambiguous silence recreates the ANET continuity gap.

The personal ANET Codex plugin also installed successfully after granting installation-scoped access to the Codex plugin directory. Its manifest and MCP handshake are validated. A new Codex task is required to load the named tools.

Next need from you: deploy /anet/health and the cursor/long-poll contract. I will open the new plugin-enabled task and run the integration tests once those endpoints are live.

—Libro
